stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It is categorized under key NLP/ML tags including 'transformers', 'llama', and 'text-generation'.
This indicates active community interest and benchmarking activity around a major LLM release.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: AMD is acquiring AI research lab World Labs in an all-stock deal valued at over $8.2 billion.
World Labs was co-founded by prominent researcher Dr. Fei-Fei Li and launched in 2024.
The acquisition targets World Labs' capabilities, including its world generation model.

stories.title: AI is supercharging hacking, and your local hospitals and banks aren’t ready
stories.author: Hayden Field
bullet_points: AI is being leveraged to supercharge hacking capabilities, posing a significant security threat.
The vulnerability extends to critical infrastructure, specifically mentioning local hospitals and banks.
A case study involving a nonprofit highlights how sensitive financial data can be targeted by these emerging threats.

stories.title: SpaceX's Starship goes orbital, deploying first next-gen Starlinks
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: SpaceX successfully achieved orbital flight with its Starship vehicle.
The mission included the deployment of next-generation Starlink satellites.
This marks a significant milestone in the development and operational capability of the Starship system.

stories.title: Right Answer, Wrong Reason: Accuracy, Consistency, and Consensus Are Misleading Indicators of LLM Faithfulness in Clinical Decision Support
stories.author: Vishnu Surya Reddy Nandi
bullet_points: LLMs in clinical decision support can be accurate but may lack faithful reasoning.
The paper introduces three new metrics (ESI, CFS) to quantify this 'faithfulness gap'.
These metrics assess reasoning consistency and causal links rather than just output accuracy.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation tasks, indicating its capability in conversational AI.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors, placing it within the current LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The model is categorized under key AI/ML tags like 'transformers' and 'llama'.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed to run locally on user hardware for multi-step, context-aware tasks.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the use of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in its MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, integrating with local LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: OpenAI’s AI agents need to catch up
stories.author: Hayden Field
bullet_points: OpenAI is reportedly lagging in the development of continuously running, consumer-facing AI agents.
The company is expected to attempt to regain leadership in the AI agent space around its upcoming 2026 DevDay.
Rumors suggest OpenAI may launch its own AI agent, tentatively named 'Aeon'.

stories.title: Experts worry about Nvidia's AI chip sales in China and influence over Trump
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: China is reportedly considering allowing major tech firms like ByteDance and Alibaba to purchase restricted Nvidia AI chips.
The situation highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions and export controls impacting the global AI hardware market.
The report also touches upon potential political influence dynamics related to the topic and the Trump administration.

stories.title: Florida invokes extinction fears in legal bid to halt OpenAI development
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: Florida is legally challenging OpenAI's development of Large Language Models (LLMs).
The state frames LLMs as a severe threat to civilization.
The legal argument labels the technology as 'the greatest public nuisance ever created.'

stories.title: The Decomposition Tax: LLM Pipelines Lose Up to 40 Accuracy Points at Their Own Interfaces
stories.author: Henghui Xiao
bullet_points: The study quantifies a 'Decomposition Tax,' showing that breaking down LLM tasks into multi-stage pipelines causes significant accuracy degradation.
Accuracy loss reached up to 40.5 points on complex math benchmarks (MATH-500) when intermediate stages lose visibility of the original problem.
The research is broad, testing this effect across 21 open-weight models from nine different organizations.

stories.title: Prompt Injection Is the New SQL Injection (and We're Not Ready)
stories.author: james_anderson_h
bullet_points: Prompt Injection is being framed as a critical security vulnerability analogous to SQL Injection.
The article highlights the unpreparedness of current systems to handle these emerging AI security threats.
A real-world example involves a financial services company discovering a breach via its customer-facing AI agent.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings improved performance and expanded model support.
Integration with llama.cpp enhances GGUF model compatibility across various hardware.
The update augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting Apple silicon users.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing the Nemotron 3 Ultra model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Bose starts adding Auracast to its headphones
stories.author: John Higgins
bullet_points: Bose is integrating Auracast, a new Bluetooth LE Audio feature, into its QuietComfort Ultra Headphones Gen 2.
The Ultra headphones are noted as the first from Bose to support this audio sharing technology.
Bose plans a wider rollout of Auracast support across its device lineup in the future.

stories.title: Volkswagen replaces ID.4 with all-electric Tiguan
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Volkswagen is replacing the ID.4 model with the new all-electric ID.Tiguan.
The shift reflects VW's strategy to leverage more recognizable brand names for their EV lineup.
The change is anticipated to make the transition to EVs more appealing to consumers.

stories.title: New device captures carbon dioxide by pumping it across a battery
stories.author: Scott K. Johnson
bullet_points: A new device has been developed for carbon dioxide capture.
The technology utilizes a battery system to pump CO2 across it.
The design reportedly requires less energy compared to existing CO2 capture systems.

stories.title: To keep drug prices high, pharma has been piling up the patents
stories.author: Beth Mole
bullet_points: Pharmaceutical companies are strategically using add-on patents to extend drug exclusivity.
This practice has significantly increased the effective patent life of drugs, from an initial two years to over six.
The core issue discussed is the industry tactic used to maintain high drug pricing.

stories.title: Scanning While Imagining: A Scene-Graph World Model for Robotic Ultrasound Navigation
stories.author: Yuan Bi
bullet_points: Introduces SonoGraph-WM, a world model designed for anticipatory robotic ultrasound navigation.
The model represents anatomical data using Scene Graphs (SGs) to capture structure, geometry, and spatial relationships.
It addresses a limitation in current methods by explicitly predicting how anatomical views will change based on probe motion.

stories.title: FinancialAuditBench: Benchmark Construction under Differential Privacy Using Real-World Priors
stories.author: Julia Hockenmaier
bullet_points: Introduces FinancialAuditBench, a new benchmark designed for auditing AI agents in financial services.
Addresses the challenge of measuring AI reliability in finance when proprietary or privacy-sensitive data is restricted.
Utilizes Differential Privacy and real-world priors to enable robust benchmarking despite data limitations.

stories.title: Improving LLM Collaboration via Multi-Agent Preference Learning
stories.author: Christopher Amato
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of constructing reliable reward functions in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) for LLM collaboration.
It proposes using preference learning, which learns from comparative feedback (human or AI), as an alternative to traditional reward engineering.
The core contribution is formulating preference-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) from decentralized and centralized approaches.

stories.title: Routing Drift Alone Does Not Diagnose Failure in Merged MoE LLMs
stories.author: Hongxia Yang
bullet_points: The paper addresses 'routing drift' in Merged Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, a phenomenon often mistaken for outright routing failure.
It raises a fundamental research question: whether routing drift post-merging truly signifies a failure state and what criteria should justify intervention.
The investigation is conducted across several prominent MoE architectures, including DeepSeekMoE, OLMoE, and Qwen3-MoE.

stories.title: When Can First-Order Models of Fine-Tuning Bound Forgetting?
stories.author: Wei Zhang
bullet_points: The research addresses 'catastrophic forgetting' in language models during fine-tuning, where new training erases old knowledge.
The study proposes using initial measurements (first-order response models) to predict the probability of a model forgetting specific facts.
In LoRA fine-tuning across models of 0.6B to 14B parameters, the first-order model showed a very high correlation (0.974-0.998) with actual per-fact margin changes.

stories.title: Steering Language Model Goals with Value Transplant
stories.author: Fabien Roger
bullet_points: The research addresses the problem of language models pursuing unintended goals despite apparent goal-directed behavior.
The core technique, 'value transplant,' involves shifting the model's internal activation along a 'value axis' at each token.
This method aims to retarget the model's search or objective function to align better with user intent.

stories.title: PReCache: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA Agents via Low-Rank Precomputation and Neutral Reconstruction
stories.author: Jae-Joon Kim
bullet_points: PReCache addresses memory and computation redundancy in multi-LoRA agent systems by optimizing KV cache usage.
The method utilizes Low-Rank Precomputation and Neutral Reconstruction to enable efficient KV cache sharing across specialized agents.
It aims to overcome limitations of existing sharing methods, which either require extra training or impose architectural restrictions.

stories.title: Kafila: Serving Large Language Models on a Trusted Set of Heterogeneous Commodity Machines
stories.author: Rajkumar Buyya
bullet_points: Introduces 'Kafila,' a system designed to serve Large Language Models (LLMs) using a restricted, trusted set of heterogeneous commodity machines.
Addresses a limitation of open LLM swarms, which require untrusted membership, by enforcing a bounded membership for reliable operation.
The system mandates that every admitted device must participate in the model serving pipeline, ensuring consistent performance.

stories.title: UOPD: Uncertainty-Aware Intervention for On-Policy Distillation of Multi-Turn Agents
stories.author: Hengrui Cai
bullet_points: Introduces UOPD, a new Uncertainty-Aware Intervention method for On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in multi-turn agents.
The method selectively targets high-uncertainty steps in student rollouts where the teacher exhibits low confidence, aiming to correct critical errors early.
Experimental results in ALFWorld demonstrate that targeted teacher corrections at low-confidence steps significantly improve subsequent student behavior and task success.

stories.title: 3D Point Tracking with State Space Models
stories.author: Atsushi Yamashita
bullet_points: Proposes a method for accurate 3D point tracking in dynamic scenes using State Space Models.
The system aims for metric accuracy (absolute meters) crucial for applications like autonomous driving and robotics.
The tracker is designed to operate efficiently on a single commodity GPU with a monocular, pose-free setup.

stories.title: Steering Language Model Goals with Value Transplant
stories.author: Fabien Roger
bullet_points: The research addresses the problem of language models pursuing unintended goals despite appearing goal-directed.
The study proposes 'value transplant,' a method to retarget a model's search by shifting its activation along a candidate 'value axis' at each token.
This work investigates manipulating the internal goal-tracking mechanism (the 'value axis') within reasoning models.

stories.title: Faithful Activation Verbalization: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM Representation Interpretation
stories.author: Mengnan Du
bullet_points: Addresses the problem of hallucinations and unreliability in LLM activation verbalization methods.
Introduces AVPO, a new two-stage framework designed to improve the faithfulness of these interpretations.
The framework works by first reconstructing the source text from a hidden activation before evaluation.

stories.title: RewardExplainer: Learning Reward Model Explanations from Counterfactual Preference Feedback
stories.author: Xia Hu
bullet_points: The research addresses a limitation in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) where standard Reward Models (RMs) only provide scalar scores.
RewardExplainer introduces a method to generate explanations for RM scoring decisions using counterfactual preference feedback.
This aims to move beyond predefined attributes and reduce the need for extensive manual counterfactual interventions in model interpretation.

stories.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
stories.author: Zeyuan Chen
bullet_points: Introduces 'Opera,' a new verbal critic framework designed for long-horizon coding agents.
Addresses the limitation of existing critics by tracking the impact of feedback until the underlying coding problem is resolved.
Opera treats each correction as a persistent note, allowing for more sustained and effective guidance during complex coding tasks.

stories.title: Beyond Solo and Consistency: Vindicating Multi-Agent Debate via Conditional Progressive Pruning
stories.author: Dimitris N. Metaxas
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical limitation in Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) frameworks for LLMs, where they often fail to outperform strong single-agent or consistency baselines under cost constraints.
It introduces 'Conditional Progressive Pruning' (CPP), a proposed lightweight technique designed to enhance the effectiveness of MAD systems.
The research contributes to the ongoing evaluation of scaling techniques in LLMs, specifically focusing on improving multi-agent collaboration efficiency and performance.

stories.title: On the Token Value Inequality in Efficient Reasoning
stories.author: Dongfang Liu
bullet_points: Addresses the high token consumption associated with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in LLMs.
Proposes a framework to diagnose and optimize token usage based on the finding that token value is non-uniform within a reasoning trace.
Focuses on efficiency improvements for complex LLM tasks by identifying which parts of the reasoning process contribute most to the final output.

stories.title: Simple Diffusion Language Models Are More Effective Few-Step Generators Than Reported
stories.author: Rajiv Khanna
bullet_points: The paper investigates the performance of Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) in few-step generation.
It suggests that the perceived quality gap in few-step DLM generation might be due to suboptimal sampler configuration rather than inherent model limitations.
The authors demonstrate that modest sampler sharpening can significantly improve generation quality without requiring model retraining.

stories.title: Quantization Error Is Spectrally Flat: A Single Random Probe Is a Calibrated, Data-Free Sensitivity Estimator, with Application to Budget-Targeted Mixed-Precision Quantization
stories.author: T Kennedy
bullet_points: Introduces a novel, data-free method using a single random Gaussian probe to estimate quantization error in neural network layers.
Demonstrates that the round-to-nearest quantization error is spectrally flat, allowing for this efficient estimation.
Applies the method to large models (35B MoE, 9B dense), showing the estimator maintains accuracy across varying precision levels (2-bit to 8-bit).

stories.title: MicroLLM Lab – Try 7 tiny LLM's in the browser
stories.author: logicallee
bullet_points: Introduction of MicroLLM Lab, allowing users to test several small Language Models (LLMs).
The key feature is running these tiny LLMs directly within the web browser.
This trend points towards increased accessibility and potential for on-device AI inference.

stories.title: ESP32S3 cluster running 1.58-bit (BitNet) Language model
stories.author: nkko
bullet_points: Demonstrates running a 1.58-bit (BitNet) language model on an ESP32S3 microcontroller.
Highlights the trend of deploying advanced AI models onto low-power, edge computing devices.
Indicates significant progress in model quantization and efficient hardware implementation for AI.

stories.title: Count It or Compute It: When a Tool Returns Rows, the Models That Count Them Right Spend the Tokens
stories.author: xbill
bullet_points: The article investigates a critical, often-overlooked aspect of LLM agent performance: accurately counting items returned by tools.
Models that are forced to process raw rows from a tool spend significantly more tokens (6x to 26x) compared to models given a direct count.
This highlights a trade-off between computational efficiency (token usage) and accuracy when agents interact with external data sources.

stories.title: How to Build a Real-Time Voice AI Agent with the Gemini Live API
stories.author: annie_cusack
bullet_points: The article details the process of building a real-time Voice AI Agent.
It specifically utilizes the Gemini Live API for implementation.
The content originates from a developer relations engineer at Google Cloud, suggesting practical, high-quality guidance.

stories.title: Context Compression for Coding Agents Compresses the Wrong Side of the Prompt
stories.author: reidmarlow
bullet_points: Addresses a common pain point in developing long-context coding agents: high billing costs.
Focuses on the technical issue of 'Context Compression' being applied incorrectly to the prompt.
Indicates a niche but relevant discussion within the practical application and optimization of LLMs for software engineering.
